predeclared_descriptive_logic.both: at least one within-layout reversal/strong complementary magnitude effect and differing R2-and-MAE signs across held-out layouts
predeclared_descriptive_logic.layout_variance_dominant: no substantial within-layout heterogeneity, held-out-layout R2 and MAE delta signs differ, and between-layout spread is at least within-layout spread
predeclared_descriptive_logic.mixed_trajectory_effect: some, but not all, layouts have a sign reversal or complementary within-layout magnitude heterogeneity
predeclared_descriptive_logic.token_preserving_generalizes: both COARSE and FULL have strict-majority positive trajectory and layout effects within layout, strict-majority positive held-out layout effects, and positive across-layout macro R2 delta
predeclared_descriptive_logic.trajectory_variance_dominant: every layout has a sign reversal or complementary R2-and-MAE within spread at least as large as held-out-layout spread
predeclared_descriptive_logic.trajectory_variance_low: no within-layout sign reversal and no layout whose complementary R2-and-MAE within spread reaches held-out-layout spread

limitations: These analyses are exploratory independent no-wall replication, not confirmatory.
No spatial-scramble, target-null, U1, U2, pair-holdout, or condition-shift control was run.
Descriptive hierarchy is reported without a fabricated formal variance-component model.
Pooled-row metrics are secondary; trajectory and equal-layout macros are primary.

nested_scaling_and_alpha_selection.alpha_selection_loss: unweighted arithmetic mean of validation-group MSE values
nested_scaling_and_alpha_selection.optimization: exact float64 sample-space ridge with standardized Gram reuse
nested_scaling_and_alpha_selection.outer_scaler: fit on all outer-training rows only after alpha selection
nested_scaling_and_alpha_selection.standardization: per-feature population mean/std; constant scale set to 1

nmae_std_definition: NMAE_STD = MAE / test_target_std, where test_target_std is the population (ddof=0) standard deviation of the held-out targets; null when that standard deviation is exactly zero.

optimization_equivalence.method: float64 dual ridge with identical train-only population standardization; reuse changes computation scheduling only

outer_design.test: all three trajectories from one untouched layout
outer_design.train: all trajectories from the other five layouts
